Title: PlatformIO Development Documentation Page
Summary: Documentation page component for PlatformIO development support in Cyréna. Covers requirements, indexed project layout (core + ESP-IDF), getting started workflow, and supported tasks.
Content:
## PlatformIO Development Page

**Route:** `/#/docs/platformio`
**Component:** `PlatformioDevelopmentComponent`
**Selector:** `app-platformio-development`

### Data Model

The component uses typed interfaces for all table and step data:

```typescript
interface Step {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  description: string;
}

interface CoreLayoutEntry {
  item: string;
  content: string;
  access: string;
}

interface EspIdfEntry {
  item: string;
  content: string;
  access: string;
}

interface TaskEntry {
  task: string;
  description: string;
}
```

### Component Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `extensionId` | `string` | `'cyrena.platformio'` — the extension identifier |
| `prerequisites` | `string[]` | Three requirements: VS Code, PlatformIO extension, Cyréna extension |
| `coreLayout` | `CoreLayoutEntry[]` | Core project folders/files with access levels |
| `espIdfLayout` | `EspIdfEntry[]` | ESP-IDF-specific folders/files (all read-only) |
| `steps` | `Step[]` | 7-step getting started workflow |
| `tasks` | `TaskEntry[]` | 4 tasks the AI can help with |

### Core Layout Table

| Item | Content | Access |
|------|---------|--------|
| `src` | All sub-folders; .c, .cpp, .h source files | Read / write |
| `include` | All sub-folders; header (.h) files | Read / write |
| `lib` | All sub-folders; .c, .cpp, .h library files | Read-only |
| `platformio.ini` | Project configuration file | Read-only |

### ESP-IDF Additional Layout

| Item | Content | Access |
|------|---------|--------|
| `managed_components` | All sub-folders; .c, .cpp, .h files | Read-only |
| `components` | All sub-folders; .c, .cpp, .h files | Read-only |
| `sdkconfig*` | ESP-IDF configuration files | Read-only |

### Access Badges
- `Read / write` → `badge bg-success`
- `Read-only` → `badge bg-secondary`

### Styling
- Light-themed tables with `#ffffff` background, `#212529` text
- Bootstrap `table-bordered` with `#dee2e6` borders
- Numbered step badges with `#0d6efd` background
- `alert-info` for permissions note

### Route Registration
```typescript
{
  path: 'platformio',
  loadComponent: () => import('./features/docs/components/platformio-development/platformio-development.component')
    .then(m => m.PlatformioDevelopmentComponent)
}
```

### Sidebar Entry
```typescript
{
  id: 'platformio',
  title: 'PlatformIO',
  description: 'PlatformIO project support',
  route: '/docs/platformio',
  icon: 'bi-cpu'
}
```

### Architecture Notes
- Standalone component, no imports needed
- `OnPush` change detection
- All data is `readonly` class properties (no signals needed for static content)
- Uses `@for` with `track` expressions for all lists
- Self-contained template (no `DocPageBaseComponent` wrapper)
